verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair question for a desktop file converter, but the evidence shows no such feature. Filee is driven by drag-and-drop donut menus, right-click menus, watch folders and a structured CLI (`filee convert ... --to <format>` with `--json` output). A structured CLI and an llms.txt file are building blocks an external agent could use, not the product accepting natural-language commands itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
